sources.title: Washington L&I Verify a Contractor, Tradesperson or Business
sources.supports: Official portal to confirm a window contractor's Washington registration, bond, and insurance before hiring.

sources.title: Shoreline Municipal Code Chapter 15.05 — Construction and Building Codes
sources.supports: Adds IRC R105.2(12) and IBC 105.2(15) permit exemptions: replacement of windows where no structural elements are revised and emergency escape and rescue openings are not reduced in size.

sources.title: Washington State Department of Commerce — Renovation, Repair and Painting (RRP) Program
sources.supports: RRP firm and individual certification required for renovation, repair, or painting work on pre-1978 homes and child-occupied facilities.

sources.title: Washington State Department of Commerce — Business and Homeowner Resources for Lead-Based Paint
sources.supports: Publishes certified RRP company lists for homeowners hiring contractors.
